Its BRSR disclosure classifies 100% of turnover under 'Manufacture of motor vehicle electrical equipment (Wiring Harness & Components)'. Customers primarily comprise leading automotive OEMs engaged in the design, development, manufacture, assembly, marketing and …

risks.note: BRSR flags climate change as posing acute physical risks including extreme weather events (floods, heat stress), asset damage and increased insurance premiums, with operations in water-stressed geographies creating water-availability risk; transition risks arise from evolving regulations, stakeholder expectations and the shift to a low-carbon economy. Financial implication cited is increased operating costs from energy transition, carbon compliance, climate adaptation and supply chain disruptions, plus potential loss of business if customer sustainability expectations are not met.
risks.risk: Climate and environmental transition & physical risk

risks.note: Technological innovation in materials and processes is described as critical; failure to keep pace with the evolving regulatory and market landscape may impact competitiveness and stakeholder expectations, with short-term increases in capital expenditure and R&D costs and financial impact if innovation lags market expectations.
risks.risk: Failure to keep pace with environmental innovation and technology

risks.note: Rising demand for low-carbon, sustainable, high-performance products aligned with electrification; the Company flags the risk of losing customers or market share and loss of competitiveness if those expectations are not met.
risks.risk: Product sustainability and stewardship — customer expectation risk

risks.note: Talent attraction, retention and development are described as critical for growth, and failure in talent management can impact performance, with productivity loss due to disengagement cited as the risk.
risks.risk: Talent management, diversity, equity and inclusion

risks.note: Growing global scrutiny on human rights practices creates risks of violations across operations and the supplier network, with potential legal non-compliance, business interruption and reputational loss.
risks.risk: Human rights across operations and the value chain

risks.note: BRSR reports 100% of turnover from the manufacture of motor vehicle electrical equipment (wiring harness & components) sold to automotive OEMs, so the Company's fortunes are tied entirely to one product line and to automotive OEM demand.
The Company focuses on domestic business and exports are negligible as a percentage of total turnover, leaving results dependent on the Indian automotive market with no export diversification.
risks.risk: Domestic geographic concentration with negligible exports

risks.note: The Company states it has a pass-through arrangement for copper as well as foreign exchange for most of its customers and hence does not undertake direct commodity price or foreign exchange risk hedging — leaving residual exposure for customers not covered by the pass-through arrangement.
risks.risk: Commodity (copper) and foreign exchange exposure managed through customer pass-through

sk.overview: The industry covers control-intensive, critical-to-the-application electronic control units (ECUs) for the mobility (2/3-wheeler) and industrial (generator/genset) markets. In mobility, ECUs (ISG, EFI, ISG+EFI, EV motor control units) are indispensable to vehicle function; adoption is driven by regulation (emissions/efficiency) and OEM technology transitions, with Tier-I suppliers driving innovation.
